description: This file defines the CategoryAdapter class for an Android application, which manages a RecyclerView displaying categories, including special items for adding and clearing categories. It handles binding data to views, managing click events, and updating the category list.

classes.name: CategoryAdapter
classes.description: Adapter class for displaying categories in a RecyclerView, including special items for adding and clearing categories.

classes.name: CategoryAdapter.CategoryViewHolder
classes.description: ViewHolder class holding references to item views for category display.

methods.name: CategoryAdapter
methods.description: Constructor initializing the adapter with context and listener.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates and returns a new ViewHolder for a category item.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data to the ViewHolder based on the category item at the given position.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of category items.

methods.name: setCategoryList
methods.description: Updates the category list with new data and manages special items for 'no category' and 'add category'.
